details.description: FLUX.1 Kontext [max] is Black Forest Labs' higher-tier image generation and editing model, unifying text-to-image generation with in-context, instruction-based image editing in a single model. Per Black Forest Labs' documentation, it offers improved prompt adherence and typography generation compared to the Kontext [pro] tier while preserving character and style consistency across iterative edits. Black Forest Labs' current developer docs now recommend FLUX.2 over FLUX.1 Kontext for new projects, citing higher resolution (up to 4MP) and multi-reference support, positioning Kontext as a previous-generation model that remains available via its API.
advantages: Black Forest Labs states it offers improved prompt adherence and typography generation compared to FLUX.1 Kontext [pro].
Supports iterative, multi-turn editing while preserving character consistency across edits, per Black Forest Labs' documentation.
Accepts input images up to 20MB or 20 megapixels and supports aspect ratios from 3:7 to 7:3, per Black Forest Labs' documentation.
disadvantages: Black Forest Labs now recommends FLUX.2 over FLUX.1 Kontext for new image generation and editing projects, citing higher resolution (up to 4MP) and multi-reference support.
Outputs are limited to roughly 1 megapixel total resolution, per Black Forest Labs' documentation.
use_cases: Targeted local edits to specific regions of an existing image
In-image text replacement and typography-focused edits
